query: INSERT INTO org_links_pages (org_id, menu_display_enabled, menu_display_title_en, menu_display_title_ar, menu_display_branch_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET menu_display_enabled = EXCLUDED.menu_display_enabled, menu_display_title_en = EXCLUDED.menu_display_title_en, menu_display_title_ar = EXCLUDED.menu_display_title_ar, menu_display_branch_id = EXCLUDED.menu_display_branch_id, updated_at = now()
